title: Exterior tensor pairing from a local natural linear map
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A,B,C$ sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $f:A\to B$ a morphism, $r,s,n\in\mathbb N$ with $n=r+s$, and $U\subseteq X$ open. For every $W\subseteq U$ let $t_W:C(W)\to B(W)$ be $\mathcal O_X(W)$-linear, and assume these maps commute with every restriction $W\supseteq Z$. Using exterior sheaves [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] and their sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], there exists a natural family of linear maps $d_W:(\bigwedge^r A\otimes\bigwedge^s C)(W)\to(\bigwedge^n B)(W)$ such that $d_W((\bigwedge_i a_i)\otimes(\bigwedge_j c_j))=\bigwedge(f_W(a_1),\ldots,f_W(a_r),t_W(c_1),\ldots,t_W(c_s))$ for all tuples $a\in A(W)^r$ and $c\in C(W)^s$, in this order and reindexed by $n=r+s$. No splitting, exactness, rank or local freeness is assumed, and no uniqueness is asserted.

proof.text: For the open inclusion j:U→X put V(W)=j(image)(j(preimage)(W))=U∩W and H=j_*(exteriorSheaf B (r+s)|U). On each V contained in U, exteriorPower.map for f and t, multiplication in the exterior algebra, and the target sheafification unit define a bilinear map beta_V from the two exterior presheaf sections. Degree closure follows from pow_add and Submodule.mul_mem_mul. The formula on pure wedges follows from exteriorPower.map_apply_ιMulti and ExteriorAlgebra.ιMulti_mul_ιMulti. Verify naturality on pure wedges using naturality of f,t and the unit, then extend to arbitrary exterior presheaf sections by exteriorPower.ιMulti_span and span induction in each factor.

For any W, restrict both exterior presheaf inputs to V(W) and apply beta_V(W), obtaining a bilinear map b_W into H(W). Its O_X(W)-linearity follows because Scheme.Hom.app_appIso_inv identifies the scalar action in the pushforward of an open restriction with ordinary restriction O_X(W)→O_X(V(W)). For Z contained in W, V(Z) is contained in V(W); equality of the two inclusion composites and naturality of beta prove naturality of b. Apply existsUnique_bilinear_sheafification_extension for the identity ring map, locally injective and locally surjective, then tensor_bilinear_universal to obtain phi: exteriorSheaf A r tensor exteriorSheaf C s → H.

On every W contained in U, the unit of the open-restriction adjunction on exteriorSheaf B n is bijective: Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app identifies it with restriction to V(W)=W, hence with an isomorphism. Define d_W by composing phi_W with the inverse of this linear equivalence. Naturality of phi and the unit proves naturality of d after applying the injective unit component. The pure-tensor equation of phi, the unit equation of the bilinear sheafification extension, naturality of beta along V(W)→W, and beta_W pure-wedge formula give the asserted formula, again after applying that injective component. Empty blocks, empty opens and zero rings introduce no exceptional assumptions.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorTensor_local_pairing {X : Scheme.{v}} {A B C : X.Modules}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (r n s : ℕ) (hr : n = r + s) (U : X.Opens)
    (t : ∀ W : X.Opens, W ≤ U →
      C.val.obj (op W) →ₗ[X.presheaf.obj (op W)] B.val.obj (op W))
    (ht : ∀ (W Z : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ U) (hZW : Z ≤ W) b,
      B.val.map (homOfLE hZW).op (t W hW b) =
        t Z (hZW.trans hW) (C.val.map (homOfLE hZW).op b)) :
    ∃ d : ∀ W : X.Opens, W ≤ U →
      (exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf C s).val.obj (op W)
        →ₗ[X.presheaf.obj (op W)] (exteriorSheaf B n).val.obj (op W),
      (∀ W hW (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op W)) (b : Fin s → C.val.obj (op W)),
        d W hW (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection A r W a)
          (exteriorSheafSection C s W b)) =
        exteriorSheafSection B n W
          (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ f.val.app (op W) (a j))
            (fun j ↦ t W hW (b j)) (Fin.cast hr i))) ∧
      (∀ (W Z : X.Opens) (hW : W ≤ U) (hZW : Z ≤ W) y,
        (exteriorSheaf B n).val.map (homOfLE hZW).op (d W hW y) =
          d Z (hZW.trans hW)
            ((exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf C s).val.map (homOfLE hZW).op y))
